cause: A restored short continuation can time out before its first new tool call; the prior keyword/current-tool gate skipped recovery.
fix: All tool-enabled turns get one bounded generation recovery without an English action keyword. The recovery follows the latest request and uses tools only when needed.
guards: completed current-turn mutations are not replayed in the recovery response
limitations: Local mock generation only; no guarantee that the source model will finish every task.
Already-running CLI requires exit/restart to load the installed update.
